sources.excerpt: Published on September 4, 2012 Tribute Audio Designs overdrive pedal Information Tribute Audio Designs The Classy Lady is a tribute to the classic TS-808 Tube Screamer, and to Jack Orman 's Son of Screamer. Arguably one of the most versatile and popular pedals of all time, the Tube Screamer is known for its tube like breakup, while retaining the clarity of the original signal. This pedal gives you the grit without ever getting muddy, even when playing chords. While the TS sounds great as-is, it is known to be killer when used to drive the front end of a tube amp to give additional saturation and sustain to your lead tones. It can clean up with the volume knob of your guitar to give jangly rhythm tones too. The Classy Lady builds on the original by simplifying the circuit, and adding asymmetrical clipping to give an even more natural, sparkling sound and pleasing harmonics. The tone control has been tweaked to give greater range - from cutting treble boosting to smooth lead sounds. With true bypass switching, this Lady will not interfere with your tone when switched off. Truly a classic, the Classy Lady demands a home in every user's arsenal. sources.excerpt: Brand: Tribute Audio Designs $160.00 Out of stock Notify me when it’s back in stock Body The Classy Lady is a tribute to the classic TS-808 Tube Screamer, and to Jack Orman’s Son of Screamer. Arguably one of the most versatile and popular pedals of all time, the Tube Screamer is known for its tube-like breakup, while retaining the clarity of the original signal. This pedal gives you the grit without ever getting muddy, even when playing chords. While the TS sounds great as-is, it is known to be killer when used to drive the front end of a tube amp to give additional saturation and sustain to your lead tones. It can clean up with the volume knob of your guitar to give jangly rhythm tones too. The Classy Lady pedal builds on the original by simplifying the circuit, and adding asymmetrical clipping to give an even more natural, sparkling sound and pleasing harmonics. The tone control has been tweaked to give greater range – from cutting treble boosting to smooth lead sounds. A switch to engage a bass boost, and a clipping select switch have also been added to give even more versatility to this pedal. With true bypass switching, this Lady will not interfere with your tone when switched off.
